itinerary.overview: A wonderful trip full of exploration, culture, and memorable experiences. Your 7-night trip to Barcelona has been planned to balance your interests in food, culture with your budget travel style.

activities.name: City Walking Tour
activities.description: Explore the historic city center on foot with a local guide, visiting key landmarks and hidden gems.
activities.reasonForRecommendation: Perfect for first-day orientation and cultural immersion.

activities.name: Local Food Market
activities.description: Discover the flavors of the region at a bustling local market with dozens of vendors.
activities.reasonForRecommendation: Best way to taste authentic local cuisine at reasonable prices.

activities.name: Cultural Museum
activities.description: An impressive museum showcasing the history and art of the region.
activities.reasonForRecommendation: Highly rated by travelers interested in local history and culture.

activities.name: Sunset Viewpoint
activities.description: Watch the sunset from a scenic viewpoint with panoramic views of the city.
activities.reasonForRecommendation: A magical, free experience that should not be missed.

activities.name: Traditional Dinner
activities.description: Enjoy a traditional evening meal at a well-regarded local restaurant.
activities.reasonForRecommendation: End the day with authentic local flavors in a cozy setting.

activities.name: Morning Yoga / Meditation Session
activities.description: Start the day with a calming yoga session at a local studio or park.
activities.reasonForRecommendation: A rejuvenating start to an activity-filled day.

activities.name: Street Art & Neighborhoods Walk
activities.description: Wander through colorful neighborhoods admiring local murals and street art.
activities.reasonForRecommendation: Free, highly photogenic, and gives insight into local culture.

activities.name: Cooking Class
activities.description: Learn to prepare traditional local dishes from a professional chef.
activities.reasonForRecommendation: An interactive, hands-on way to connect with local food culture.

activities.name: Evening River Cruise
activities.description: See the city from the water on a relaxing evening boat tour.
activities.reasonForRecommendation: Romantic and scenic; a wonderful way to end the day.

activities.name: Nature Hike or Scenic Trek
activities.description: Hike through stunning natural landscapes with panoramic views.
activities.reasonForRecommendation: Perfect for adventure-seekers and nature lovers.

activities.name: Local Craft & Souvenir Shopping
activities.description: Browse artisan shops and markets for unique local crafts and keepsakes.
activities.reasonForRecommendation: Great for picking up authentic handmade souvenirs.

activities.name: Rooftop Bar & Nightlife
activities.description: Experience the city's vibrant nightlife at a well-known rooftop bar.
activities.reasonForRecommendation: Fantastic city views and a lively atmosphere to end the trip.

Download offline maps before you go to save data.
Book major attractions in advance to avoid queues.
Travel insurance is highly recommended for international trips.
